Core.Base.purpose: Owns the foundational System and SharpRuntime types: primitive aliases, Object and Type identity, exceptions, Array and Span helpers, delegates, nullable values, versioning, environment helpers, and other cross-cutting contracts.
Core.Base.platform: Predominantly portable C++23, with explicitly guarded operating-system helpers. It is an opt-in native object model, not a CLR or universal base-object layer.

Console.purpose: Provides familiar Console input, output, color, cursor, and key APIs over native terminal facilities.
Console.platform: Basic stream output is broadly portable. Color, cursor, and key behavior depends on the host terminal and should not be treated as a virtualized .NET console.

Uri.purpose: Implements URI construction, decomposition, escaping, comparison, and related enums for ports that use System.Uri-shaped code.
Uri.platform: The parser is native and portable; compatibility is a curated contract rather than a promise of every .NET URI normalization edge case.

TimeZone.purpose: Implements TimeZoneInfo-shaped lookup, offsets, conversions, adjustment rules, and time-zone exceptions.
TimeZone.platform: Windows and POSIX data paths differ, and Emscripten behavior is reduced. Transition, ambiguity, and serialization behavior must be evaluated against the documented subset.

Buffers.purpose: Provides buffer-writing, binary primitive, operation-status, and text-buffer primitives used by serialization and high-throughput APIs.
Buffers.platform: Header-oriented and portable. Span and Memory views remain native non-owning views; their owners and storage addresses must outlive every operation.

Collections.Core.purpose: Owns generic, immutable, frozen, concurrent, specialized, and non-generic collection contracts and implementations used throughout the runtime.
Collections.Core.platform: Portable native containers with explicit value and pointer ownership. Mutation, iterator invalidation, comparers, and exception behavior are not supplied by a managed runtime.

Collections.Blocking.purpose: Adds BlockingCollection and producer-consumer coordination over the core collection and threading layers.
Collections.Blocking.platform: Uses native synchronization and blocking. Shutdown, cancellation, and object lifetime must be coordinated explicitly by the caller.

Collections.Async.purpose: Defines asynchronous enumerable and enumerator contracts used by task-oriented ports.
Collections.Async.platform: This is a native interface surface; it does not add C# async-iterator syntax or a CLR scheduler.

Collections.ObjectModel.purpose: Provides collection wrappers and observable/change-notification collections aligned with System.Collections.ObjectModel patterns.
Collections.ObjectModel.platform: Portable, but notifications execute as native callbacks. Subscription removal, reentrancy, captures, and thread safety remain explicit concerns.

ComponentModel.purpose: Provides component-model events, attributes, conversion helpers, cancellation arguments, and data-annotation types used by higher layers.
ComponentModel.platform: Attributes are ordinary C++ types rather than CLR metadata. Dynamic discovery and reflection-based component activation are outside this layer.

Diagnostics.purpose: Owns tracing, debugging, stopwatch, stack, process, and code-analysis-shaped surfaces.
Diagnostics.platform: Stopwatch and basic diagnostics are portable; process and stack facilities depend strongly on the operating system. Source presence is not equivalent to a current cross-platform runtime gate.

Globalization.purpose: Provides cultures, calendars, regions, text elements, comparison options, and numeric/date formatting support.
Globalization.platform: This is a curated native data and locale layer, not ICU or the complete .NET globalization database. Unicode collation, casing, graphemes, and locale coverage are intentionally reduced.

Numerics.purpose: Owns BigInteger, Decimal, vectors, matrices, quaternion, complex numbers, wide integers, and numeric helper types.
Numerics.platform: Several wide numeric surfaces depend on native __int128. Compiler capability is therefore part of the public portability boundary, especially for current MSVC configurations.

Runtime.purpose: Provides compiler-services, interop, exception-services, serialization markers, runtime helpers, handles, and selected environment/runtime facilities.
Runtime.platform: Many declarations are compatibility-shaped native helpers, not CLR services. Boxing, metadata reflection, assembly loading, and general interop activation are deliberately absent or reduced.

Text.purpose: Owns StringBuilder, encodings, formatting, Unicode helpers, web encoders, Base64, and other System.Text-shaped algorithms.
Text.platform: The common String representation is UTF-8 bytes in std::string. Several case, comparison, indexing, normalization, and grapheme operations are narrower than .NET UTF-16/globalization semantics.

Text.Json.purpose: Provides JSON documents, nodes, readers, writers, serializers, options, converters, metadata, and JSON exceptions over a native JSON backend.
Text.Json.platform: Portable header-heavy API backed by vendored nlohmann JSON. Matching type names do not imply complete System.Text.Json converter, metadata, or source-generation parity.

Text.RegularExpressions.purpose: Provides Regex, Match, Group, Capture, and option-shaped APIs for familiar regular-expression workflows.
Text.RegularExpressions.platform: The native backend and Unicode model do not implement every .NET regex construct or culture-sensitive behavior. Treat patterns as a tested subset rather than source-compatible regex bytecode.

Threading.purpose: Owns threads, monitors, events, locks, cancellation, thread pool, synchronization context, atomics, and related primitives.
Threading.platform: Built on native C++ and operating-system facilities. Scheduling, teardown, callback lifetime, fairness, and Emscripten pthread configuration differ from the CLR.

Threading.Tasks.purpose: Provides Task, TaskCompletionSource, continuations, schedulers, awaiter-shaped helpers, and aggregate task coordination.
Threading.Tasks.platform: These are native task objects and continuations, not C# async/await execution semantics. Ownership, observation, cancellation, and scheduler lifetime remain explicit.

Threading.Channels.purpose: Provides bounded and unbounded channel readers, writers, options, and completion coordination.
Threading.Channels.platform: Portable native synchronization. Backpressure and shutdown behavior should be designed together with task/cancellation ownership.

Timers.purpose: Provides Timer and timer-event patterns for delayed and periodic native callbacks.
Timers.platform: Callbacks run under native scheduling and can race disposal or captured owners. Timing precision and dispatch context are host-dependent.

IO.purpose: Owns the Stream model, memory/file streams, binary and text readers/writers, paths, files, directories, metadata, random access, and FileSystemWatcher.
IO.platform: Windows and POSIX filesystem behavior differs; several types have narrower lifecycle or encoding contracts. FileSystemWatcher is Linux/inotify-only at the pinned source.

IO.Compression.purpose: Provides compression streams and codecs over ZLIB for Deflate, GZip, and related compression modes.
IO.Compression.platform: Requires ZLIB and links it privately. Stream ownership, flush/finalization, and invalid input errors follow native resource rules.

IO.Compression.Zip.purpose: Provides ZIP archive and entry operations as a distinct component over vendored miniz.
IO.Compression.Zip.platform: Vendored miniz is private to the component. Archive format support and update semantics are a curated subset and this physical component has no dedicated test executable at the pin.

IO.Hashing.purpose: Provides CRC and non-cryptographic hash algorithms for checksums and content processing.
IO.Hashing.platform: Portable algorithms. These checksums and non-cryptographic hashes must not be presented as authentication or password-storage primitives.

Storage.purpose: Provides application storage-path discovery used by platform integrations and CNA-style consumers.
Storage.platform: Android integration expects a parent-provided SDL3 target. This small physical component has no dedicated test executable at the pin.

IO.IsolatedStorage.purpose: Provides store-relative file and directory operations with quota and lifecycle concepts familiar from isolated storage.
IO.IsolatedStorage.platform: The current confinement resolver rejects traversal and absolute escapes, but this remains a native filesystem facility rather than a complete operating-system security sandbox; TOCTOU and symlink-sensitive operations require care.

Net.purpose: Owns IP addresses, DNS, endpoints, credentials, cookies, web utilities, and shared networking contracts.
Net.platform: Windows and POSIX socket paths exist; Emscripten and host-network facilities are reduced. DNS and interface availability are environmental inputs.

Net.Sockets.purpose: Provides Socket, TCP/UDP clients and listeners, options, event arguments, and protocol enums over native sockets.
Net.Sockets.platform: Windows and POSIX implementations differ. Async wrappers retain native ownership and caller-buffer risks; IPv6 and raw-socket behavior depend on host facilities and permissions.

Net.Http.purpose: Provides HttpClient, request/response messages, content types, handlers, and completion options over the socket layer.
Net.Http.platform: The pinned transport is buffered plain HTTP/1.1. HTTPS/TLS and automatic redirect parity are not part of the current implementation.

Net.Http.Headers.purpose: Provides strongly named HTTP request, response, content, and general header value types.
Net.Http.Headers.platform: Portable parsing and formatting helpers. Header type breadth does not add transport features such as TLS, HTTP/2, or managed handler pipelines.

Net.Http.Json.purpose: Connects HTTP content and client helpers with the Text.Json serializer surface.
Net.Http.Json.platform: Inherits both the native JSON subset and the plain-HTTP transport boundary; examples must not imply HTTPS support.

Net.Mime.purpose: Provides media-type and content-disposition names and helper types used by mail and HTTP-shaped code.
Net.Mime.platform: Portable value and parsing surface; it is not a complete mail transfer or MIME message engine.

Net.NetworkInformation.purpose: Provides Ping, network/interface information, statistics, address-change events, and related result types.
Net.NetworkInformation.platform: Ping permissions and raw ICMP behavior depend on the host. Interface enumeration is currently Linux-specific and accounts for one class of environment-sensitive gate evidence.

Net.Security.purpose: Provides security-protocol, authentication, negotiation, and protection-level shaped declarations used by networking ports.
Net.Security.platform: This component does not establish a supported TLS/certificate/SslStream transport. Security-shaped names must not be mistaken for an end-to-end secure channel.

Net.WebSockets.purpose: Provides WebSocket client, framing, state, options, close status, and result types over native networking.
Net.WebSockets.platform: Supports ws:// transport at the pinned source. wss:// requires TLS that the current runtime does not provide, and async owner lifetime must remain explicit.

Security.purpose: Owns principal, identity, permission, authentication, and security exception-shaped contracts used by other components.
Security.platform: A compatibility surface, not a CLR code-access-security system. Authentication and authorization guarantees depend on the concrete API and platform.

Security.Cryptography.purpose: Provides hashes, HMAC, PBKDF2, cryptographic operations, and related algorithm/value types.
Security.Cryptography.platform: This is not a complete cryptographic platform: encryption suites, certificate validation, TLS, and SslStream are outside the current promise.

Security.Cryptography.Random.purpose: Provides operating-system-backed cryptographic random number generation as a narrow separately selectable component.
Security.Cryptography.Random.platform: Uses platform entropy facilities, including BCrypt on Windows. This physical component has no dedicated test executable at the pin.

Xml.purpose: Provides XML readers, writers, documents, schema and XPath-shaped APIs over vendored tinyxml2 plus native wrappers.
Xml.platform: tinyxml2 is a public dependency because public headers expose it. XPath, schema, DTD, and extensibility behavior are curated subsets, not full System.Xml parity.

Xml.Linq.purpose: Provides XDocument, XElement, names, nodes, attributes, annotations, and LINQ-to-XML-shaped operations.
Xml.Linq.platform: Portable native object graph built above Xml. Namespace and lexical validation have current remediation coverage, while event/change semantics and broader LINQ integration remain narrower than .NET.
